verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal documents a public REST API covering voice, SMS, messaging, video, fax, data and system configuration. It includes a getting-started flow (register app, auth credential, first API call), an API reference (e.g., Call-Log readUserCallLog), event subscriptions, scoped app permissions, and official JavaScript/Java/.NET SDKs. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, which limits machine discoverability but does not contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: RingCentral provides a suite of powerful APIs for voice, SMS/MMS, team messaging, video, fax, data management and system configuration.
